description: Fictional public data. No personal memory or customer data.

notes.title: Work preferences
notes.body: Use Spanish for project updates. Use exactly three bullet points. State each decision and its reason.

notes.title: Parcel event queue decision
notes.body: Use the outbox pattern for Parcel events. Reason: an event and its database change must commit together. Do not add a distributed transaction.

notes.title: Parcel invoice handoff
notes.body: The invoice parser is complete. Next step: test duplicate invoice imports. The unresolved blocker is a missing sandbox account.

notes.title: Parcel application
notes.body: Parcel handles delivery orders.

notes.title: Route calculation service
notes.body: The Route calculation service depends on the Harbor geocoding vendor. Its owner is the Cartography team.

notes.title: Parcel escalation owner old record
notes.body: The escalation owner was the Cedar team.

notes.title: Parcel escalation owner current record
notes.body: The escalation owner is the Willow team. This record replaces the Cedar team record.

notes.title: Parcel vendor certificate
notes.body: The Parcel vendor certificate was valid at its last check. This source cannot establish current validity.

notes.title: Parcel upload quota operations report
notes.body: Operations reports a Parcel upload quota of 18 MB. The report conflicts with the support report. Neither report has priority.

notes.title: Parcel upload quota support report
notes.body: Support reports a Parcel upload quota of 24 MB. The report conflicts with the operations report. Neither report has priority.

notes.title: Parcel restore procedure
notes.body: First stop the database. Then restore the dump into a new empty database. Never restore over the active database.

notes.title: Parcel charge allocation
notes.body: Use exact decimal arithmetic for charge allocation. Allocation shares must sum to one. Reason: binary rounding can change the amount.

notes.title: Parcel revenue definition
notes.body: Parcel net revenue excludes refunded orders and sales tax. The Revenue Operations team owns this definition.

notes.title: Parcel renewal risk hypothesis
notes.body: An agent inferred that the Harbor vendor might not renew its contract. This is an unverified hypothesis. There is no source that confirms non-renewal.

notes.title: Orchard queue
notes.body: Orchard uses direct event delivery. It is a separate project.

notes.title: Orchard escalation owner
notes.body: The Orchard escalation owner is the Birch team. This does not apply to Parcel.

notes.title: Orchard revenue
notes.body: Orchard gross revenue includes sales tax. Orchard is separate from Parcel.

notes.title: Orchard restore
notes.body: The Orchard file archive has a separate restore procedure.

notes.title: Orchard quota
notes.body: The Orchard upload quota is 64 MB. This does not apply to Parcel.

notes.title: Orchard handoff
notes.body: The next Orchard task is to replace a logo. There is no relation to the Parcel invoice work.
